gaya: DRAFT gawaan (R-37): 'Ops Ledger' - dark graphite, satu aksen amber, IBM Plex. Dial: ENERGY 2 / RHYTHM 2 / MOTION 1. Motif identitas: honesty-tag di setiap angka (TERUKUR solid / BELUM TERVERIFIKASI dashed).
STYLE_PRE: STYLE (apply exactly): a 390px-wide MOBILE app screen for 'War Room', an Indonesian personal trading control room (one operator). Dark graphite theme: page background #101214; layered cards #17191C and #1D2126 with 1px hairline borders #2A2F36; corner radius 6px; flat surfaces, no glassmorphism, no glow, no gradient backgrounds, at most one card may carry a subtle elevation. Text #E8EAED, secondary text #9AA1A9, hairline dividers instead of floating cards. AMBER #F5B83D is the single accent (war-room lamp): only on the one focal decision element of the screen and the active nav item. MINT #34E39A ONLY marks measurable positive values. RED #FF6B6B ONLY marks risk/negative values and is ALWAYS paired with a text glyph (−, ▼, !) plus words, never color alone. Headlines and body: IBM Plex Sans; ALL numerals and micro-labels: IBM Plex Mono, labels uppercase 10px letter-spaced. EVERY number carries a tiny honesty tag inline: solid dot 'TERUKUR' or dashed-border chip 'BELUM TERVERIFIKASI', plus its source in mono microtext. Absent data prints '—' never 0, with a one-line reason. No lorem, no invented statistics, no decorative dots, no emoji, no charts without axis labels and a question as its title. Bottom navigation bar, 5 compact items min 44px tap: Beranda, Pasar (group), Berita, Sistem, Lainnya; active item amber. Single reflowing column, tap targets full width where lists. All UI copy in Bahasa Indonesia; technical terms (paper trade, snapshot, edge, walk-forward) stay English. Real content rules: the only numeric facts allowed are those quoted in the prompt; everything else shows '—' with its reason.
